name: Dishwater Nell
text: Start of your turn: replace your shop's lowest-tier unit with one of your tier. If 2+ tiers up and touching an Ooze: gain 1 gold.
golden_text: Start of your turn: replace your shop's 2 lowest-tier units with ones of your tier. If one went 2+ tiers up and touching an Ooze: gain 2 gold.
